tools.name: quote_transfer
tools.description: Price every route between `from` and `to` at this size, across P2P venues, payment rails, withdrawal networks and swap providers. Returns the best route with each leg's cost, up to four alternatives, the all-in cost in bps against mid-market, and a confidence level. Needs an API key.

tools.name: list_currencies
tools.description: Without `code`: every covered local currency with its rails. With `code` (e.g. "NGN"): the live mid rate against USDT and the payment rails available.

tools.name: get_p2p_ads
tools.description: The P2P ads (Bybit, Binance) that can fill an order of this size in a local currency, after reputation and AI screening, best first.

tools.name: market_overview
tools.description: The live all-in cost to buy and sell USDT in every covered currency at a standard size, for benchmarking corridors. With `code`, returns that corridor's history instead.

tools.name: quote_swap
tools.description: Best of Relay and NEAR Intents for a token-to-token swap, e.g. USDT:tron → USDC:base. With `executable: true` and the user's addresses, also returns the transaction or deposit address to execute it from the user's own wallet.

tools.name: list_swap_assets
tools.description: Tokens and chains the swap layer routes, as asset keys like "USDC:sol".

tools.name: track_swap
tools.description: Status of a swap started from an executable quote.

tools.name: naira_derivatives
tools.description: The cNGN index, futures curve and options chain on Numo: what the market prices the naira at for future dates.

tools.name: naira_risk
tools.description: The naira risk watchdog: calm, watch or step_aside, with reasons, market signals (24-hour move, street premium over the official index, futures-implied fall) and the recent headlines TypeSafe Jev judged. The Carry vault steps out of naira exposure at step_aside.

tools.name: lock_rate
tools.description: Price a rate lock for a future naira payment from the on-chain futures book: the locked rate, premium over today, margin needed, and the order to sign. Prices only; nothing is placed. Needs an API key.

tools.name: price_carry
tools.description: Compare ways to earn naira interest rates on dollars (T-bills, hedged and unhedged), with outcomes under different devaluation scenarios. Needs an API key.

tools.name: get_vaults
tools.description: The non-custodial vaults on Base (ERC-4626, USDC). Without `id`: all vaults with live state. With `id`: TVL, share price, liquidity, fees and allocations; add `account` for a wallet's position, or `historyDays` for share price and realised APY over time.

tools.name: build_vault_transaction
tools.description: Build (and simulate) the calls for a deposit, withdrawal or redemption, for the user's own wallet to sign. Smart wallets send `calls` as one batch; plain wallets sign the returned permit. Nothing is signed or sent here.

tools.name: vault_deposit_route
tools.description: Route a vault deposit from any token on any chain (e.g. USDT on Tron) into USDC vault shares on Base, with the transactions or deposit address to pay.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the LandedFX documentation and API reference. Returns the most relevant sections with links. Use for integration questions: auth, notation, errors, guides, endpoints.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: A full docs page as Markdown, by path: "quickstart", "authentication", "concepts/notation", "guides/vaults", "guides/rate-locks"… Use "index" for the overview, "llms" for the page list.

tools.name: get_free_api_key
tools.description: Issue a free LandedFX API key (60 requests a minute, 5,000 calls a month) for the user, by name and email. The key is shown once: tell the user to store it and add it to their MCP client and app as the x-api-key header. One free key per email.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: The calling API key's plan, limits and usage this month.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_free_api_key · Private data: quote_transfer, quote_swap, list_swap_assets, naira_risk, lock_rate, price_carry, get_vaults, build_vault_transaction, vault_deposit_route, get_free_api_key, get_usage · Public sink: get_vaults, build_vault_transaction, get_free_api_key · Destructive: quote_swap.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_free_api_key · Private data: quote_transfer, quote_swap, list_swap_assets, naira_risk, lock_rate, price_carry, get_vaults, build_vault_transaction, vault_deposit_route, get_free_api_key, get_usage · Public sink: get_vaults, build_vault_transaction, get_free_api_key · Destructive: quote_swap

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
